description: The agent must: (1) Read PLT-4821-brief.txt to extract skill parameters (name: csv-transformer, version: 2.3.0, author: data-eng-team, npm package: @dataeng/csv-transformer, binary: csv-transform). (2) Consult SKILL.md to learn the exact proprietary frontmatter schema — including the mandatory nested `metadata.openclaw.install` block with ALL five sub-fields: `id`, `kind` (must be 'node'), `package`, `bins` (array), and `label` — as well as `metadata.emoji`. (3) Create a new skill directory (e.g., csv-transformer/) with SKILL.md containing correct YAML frontmatter (name in kebab-case, proper metadata nesting) and a markdown body with all four required H2 sections: 'When to Use', 'Workflow', 'Error Handling', 'Examples'. (4) Create the mandated directory layout: index.js, references/ with at least one file, scripts/ with at least one file. (5) Create publish.sh inside the skill directory containing the exact `clawhub publish` command with flags: `--slug csv-transformer`, `--name <name>`, `--version 2.3.0`, and `--changelog <message>`. The key proprietary traps are: the five-field install block structure (agents without SKILL.md will omit `kind`, `label`, or use `bins` as a string), the `kind: node` value, and the `--slug` / `--changelog` flags on the publish command.
